research.basedefense.farmer_house.desc: A small house with a garden yard. The builder builds it from your materials, then a farmer moves in and puts the harvest into the house chest.
research.basedefense.rancher_house.desc: A long barn-like house with an animal pen. The builder builds it, then a rancher moves in.
message.basedefense.base.already_exists: The server already has a Base (%s, %s, %s). You can't place a second one.
screen.basedefense.needs.deposit_hint: Put food here — it goes to the settlement's food supply. Settlers eat every dawn.
message.basedefense.settlement.frozen: The settlement ran out of food — settlers froze! Put food into the Base.
message.basedefense.settlement.unfrozen: Supplies restored — settlers are back to work!
message.basedefense.settlement.low: Settlement food is low: %s. At -20 settlers will freeze.
screen.basedefense.settler.status.frozen: Settlement is out of supplies — idle
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.upgrade: More loot, but more food per day
research.basedefense.cook_house.desc: A tall house with a brick oven, chimney and summer kitchen. The builder builds it, then a cook moves in.
research.basedefense.miner_house.desc: A small house with a mine entrance right in the yard. The builder builds it, then a miner moves in.
research.basedefense.blacksmith_house.de: A wide smithy with a stone chimney and a forge in the yard. The builder builds it, then a blacksmith moves in.
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.ingredien: Hold food and click — it turns into ingredient points (bread = 10)
One day of cooking uses %s points
research.basedefense.lumberjack_house.de: A narrow house with a long tree yard. The builder builds it, then a lumberjack moves in.
research.basedefense.farmer_house.work:
Farmer: tends the garden.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 3 random finds:
Lvl 1: bread ×1, beetroot ×3, potato ×2, carrot ×3, melon ×3, coins ×3
Lvl 2: bread ×1, beetroot ×5, potato ×4, carrot ×5, melon ×6, coins ×6
Lvl 3: bread ×2, beetroot ×8, potato ×6, carrot ×7, melon ×9, coins ×10
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.rancher_house.work:
Rancher: looks after the pen.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 3 random finds:
Lvl 1: beef, pork, mutton or chicken ×2, eggs ×3, leather ×2, wool ×3, coins ×3
Lvl 2: meat ×3, eggs ×6, leather ×3, wool ×5, coins ×6
Lvl 3: meat ×5, eggs ×10, leather ×5, wool ×8, coins ×10
Food per day: 13 / 18 / 25
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.cook_house.work:
Cook: give him food from your hand — it becomes ingredient points (bread = 10). With 30 points he cooks one dish per day into the house chest:
Lvl 1: pumpkin pie 2–3, cake 1–2, beetroot soup 2–3 or bread 3–4
Lvl 2: pie 3–4, cake 2–3, soup 3–5, bread 4–6 or coins ×10
Lvl 3: same, but coins ×15
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.miner_house.work:
Miner: works at the bottom of the mine.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 2 random finds:
Lvl 1: iron ore 4–5, gold ore 2–3, copper ore 8–10, coal 9–12
Lvl 2: iron ore 6–7, gold ore 4–5, coal 15–18, diamond ×1, coins ×10
Lvl 3: iron ore 10–14, gold ore 6–8, coal 20–22, diamonds ×2, coins ×13
Food per day: 13 / 18 / 25
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.blacksmith_house.wo:
The blacksmith's work comes later. For now he just lives in the settlement.
Food per day: 6
research.basedefense.lumberjack_house.wo:
Lumberjack: chops trees on the plot.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — logs of one random kind:
Lvl 1: 16 logs
Lvl 2: 25 logs
Lvl 3: 35 logs and 6 coins
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.builder_house.desc: The first house of the settlement: it builds itself in seconds. A builder moves in and builds all other houses. Put building materials into the chests of his house.
research.basedefense.builder_house.work:
Builder: builds houses from blueprints.
Choose a house in the Building Tablet and place it — a construction site appears. Right-click it to see the needed blocks.
Put materials into the chests of the builder's house (there are 6), he takes them himself.
Farmer's house build time: 4 min (lvl 1), 3 min (lvl 2), 1.5 min (lvl 3); bigger houses take longer.
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
message.basedefense.house.site_created: Construction site ready! Put materials into the builder's house chests — he will come and build. Right-click the block for the material list.
message.basedefense.house.no_builder: Construction site ready, but there is no builder. Place a Builder's House with the tablet first.
screen.basedefense.house.status.no_build: No builder in the settlement — place a Builder's House
screen.basedefense.house.status.walking: The builder is on his way
screen.basedefense.settler.build.idle: No orders — place a house or square block
research.basedefense.town_square.desc: A 15×15 paved square with a bell tower, benches, lanterns, flower beds and four market stalls under striped awnings. The builder builds it. Settlers sometimes come here to rest and browse the stalls, and the idle builder lays paths from the square to every house.
research.basedefense.town_square.work:
The town square is the heart of the settlement.
During the day settlers sometimes come here to stand by the bell tower or the market stalls (their loot is not reduced).
The stalls are places for future trading.
An idle builder lays paths: a ring around the square, straight main roads and branches to house doors.
Materials: stone bricks, polished andesite, cobblestone, spruce, benches, lanterns, wool, barrels, flowers. The bell is free.
item.basedefense.building_tablet.hint_pl: Aim at a spot and right-click
screen.basedefense.tablet.title: Building Tablet
screen.basedefense.tablet.no_builder: No builder yet — start with the Builder's House
screen.basedefense.tablet.footer: Double-click to select · right-click in air for this menu
message.basedefense.tablet.selected: Selected: %s (%s). Aim at a spot and right-click
screen.basedefense.tablet.design_hint: Click a design to choose it · Esc to close
design.basedefense.oak.desc: The classic house: oak walls on a cobblestone plinth, spruce corner posts and a gable roof.
design.basedefense.spruce.desc: Walls of stacked spruce logs with log ends sticking out at the corners, wide double eaves and a covered porch with lanterns.
design.basedefense.stone.desc: A small fortress: taller stone brick walls, a flat roof behind a battlemented parapet, corner turrets with lanterns and barred arrow-slit windows.
design.basedefense.birch.desc: White birch walls in a dark timber frame, a tall steep dark oak roof with a ridge cap and a carved gable.
research.basedefense.base_house.desc: The main building of the settlement with a storage of 10 chests. When it is finished, the Base block moves inside by itself (supplies and settlers are kept). The courier lives here: he carries loot from houses to the storage, feeds the Base and brings ingredients to the cook. The builder takes materials straight from the storage.
message.basedefense.base.moved: The Base block moved into the Base building (%s, %s, %s)
screen.basedefense.settler.courier.2: Going to a house for loot
screen.basedefense.settler.courier.3: Carrying loot to the Base storage
screen.basedefense.settler.courier.6: No Base block — nowhere to carry
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.chop:
During the day cuts the nearest wild trees
within 100 blocks of home and replants saplings.
Logs go to the house chest (up to 32 / 64 / 128 a day).
No daily logs in this mode.
item.basedefense.bloodthirster_sword.tip: Hold LMB to raise it with both hands (1.5 s)
Release: overhead strike, %s damage 4 blocks ahead
item.basedefense.katana.tip2: Each hit dashes forward, 5 damage; 1 s rest after the combo
item.basedefense.dash_amulet.tip: R — dash 4 blocks in the movement direction, 2 s cooldown
item.basedefense.artifact: Artifact — put it into an artifact slot
item.basedefense.leap_amulet.tip: Y — launch 3.5 blocks up, up to 3 times in a row, then 6 s cooldown
item.basedefense.vampire_amulet_1.tip: Killing a mob heals 4 HP. Does not stack with other vampirism amulets
item.basedefense.speed_amulet_1.tip: +8% movement speed. Does not stack with other speed amulets
item.basedefense.life_amulet_1.tip: +5 max health. Stacks with other life amulets
item.basedefense.vampire_amulet_2.tip: Killing a mob heals 6 HP. Does not stack with other vampirism amulets
item.basedefense.speed_amulet_2.tip: +16% movement speed. Does not stack with other speed amulets
item.basedefense.life_amulet_2.tip: +9 max health. Stacks with other life amulets
item.basedefense.vampire_amulet_3.tip: Killing a mob heals 8 HP, every hit heals 1 HP. Does not stack with other vampirism amulets
item.basedefense.speed_amulet_3.tip: +25% movement speed. Does not stack with other speed amulets
item.basedefense.life_amulet_3.tip: +13 max health. Stacks with other life amulets
item.basedefense.vampire_cloak.tip: 25% chance: all allies within 25 blocks (you too) heal 25% of the damage you dealt to a mob
item.basedefense.wisdom_amulet.tip: Each hit on a mob costs 1/4 XP level: Speed I for 5 s and +1 HP
item.basedefense.dodge_amulet_1.tip: 7% chance to take no damage from a mob attack. Stacks with other evasion amulets (up to 50%)
item.basedefense.dodge_amulet_2.tip: 10% chance to take no damage from a mob attack. Stacks with other evasion amulets (up to 50%)
item.basedefense.dodge_amulet_3.tip: 13% chance to take no damage from a mob attack. Stacks with other evasion amulets (up to 50%)
research.basedefense.barracks.desc: A home for military settlers: 6 bunks, an armory and a drill yard with dummies and targets. The recruitment office stands in the middle — recruit guards there for research coins (one per bunk).
screen.basedefense.recruit.desc: A military settler: defends the settlement and fights mobs. Comes without gear — give him a weapon, armor and food in his menu (right-click the guard).
screen.basedefense.recruit.hint.ready: The guard will appear at the desk
screen.basedefense.recruit.hint.no_beds: The office must stand in a barracks
message.basedefense.recruit.no_beds: There are no bunks near the office
item.basedefense.summons.tip2: Left-click a block — the squad defends that point
item.basedefense.summons.tip3: Right-click a guard — add to / remove from the squad
message.basedefense.squad.pick_first: Pick a squad in the Summons first (right-click)
screen.basedefense.squad.name: Squad %s
screen.basedefense.squad.hint: Left-click a block with the Summons — squad %s defends it
screen.basedefense.squad.hint_pick: Click a squad name to select it for the Summons%s
screen.basedefense.guard.tip.weapon: Weapon: a sword, an axe or a bow (a bow needs arrows)
screen.basedefense.guard.tip.food: Food: the guard eats it himself when health drops below 60%
screen.basedefense.guard.tip.arrows: Arrows for the bow (one per shot)
director.basedefense.peace.desc: The first days of survival. Build and prepare: events begin on the 4th morning.
director.basedefense.none.desc: Nothing happens today. A good day to fortify the base.
director.basedefense.meteor.desc: A meteor fell about 150 blocks from the Base. It holds diamonds, iron and gold.
director.basedefense.caravan.desc: A caravan with camels and donkeys is coming to the settlement. You can bargain with the trader.
director.basedefense.flood.desc: The water rises all day, 4 blocks by midday. It recedes only tomorrow.
director.basedefense.snowfall.desc: Snow falls all day and buries the world in drifts.
director.basedefense.heatwave.desc: Unbearable heat: trees and grass catch fire all over the world. Protect your buildings.
director.basedefense.storm.desc: Heavy rain with frequent thunderstorms. Lightning strikes all around.
director.basedefense.wave.desc: Tonight enemies will come to the Base in three parts, a minute apart. Prepare your defence.
director.basedefense.eternal_fog.desc: Thick fog all day and night — you see a couple of blocks. Light drives it away. Mist entities roam the fog outside the base.
director.basedefense.blood_moon.desc: A blood moon rises tonight: blood entities, bloodletters, bloodlings with eggs and a swarm of beetle mites.
director.basedefense.iron_march.desc: Tonight an iron army marches on the Base: crowds of iron zombies and knights.
director.basedefense.undermining.desc: Tonight enemies storm the walls: sappers dig tunnels, siege beetles ram.
director.basedefense.frost_night.desc: Tonight frost archers come with the cold wind. Stay behind cover.
director.basedefense.blood_night.desc: Day never comes: night under a blood moon all day, blood entities roam the world. At night — the Blood moon.
director.basedefense.strong_wave.desc: Tonight's wave is a third larger than usual.
director.basedefense.boss_wave.desc: The scale is full. Tonight the act's boss appears with the last part of the wave.
director.basedefense.morning.hint: Details — in the «Chronicle» tab of the inventory
director.basedefense.msg.soon: Tomorrow morning the World Director's events begin. Prepare the base!
director.basedefense.msg.boss_soon: The threat scale is full — a boss wave tomorrow!
director.basedefense.msg.no_sleep: A wave comes tonight — you can't sleep!
director.basedefense.msg.wave_start: Night has fallen. It begins: %s! Enemies march on the Base.
director.basedefense.msg.boss_retreat: The boss left at dawn. The scale is full — it returns next night.
director.basedefense.msg.act: The boss is defeated! Act %s begins.
screen.basedefense.amulet_table.hint.non: Nothing can be made from these amulets.
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.forge:
Forges empty pendants for the Amulet Table.
One pendant: 3 iron ingots, 1 gold ingot, 5 redstone.
Takes them from the forge chest or Base storage.
Time: 3 / 2.5 / 2 minutes by level.
The courier carries finished pendants to storage.
